safetyNotes: Command all 6 servos to 1500us neutral center pulse using the ESP32 + PCA9685 before bolting the 25T aluminum horns so no joint hits a mechanical hard-stop.
Adjust the 6V switching power supply output with a multimeter before connecting the ESP32 logic rail.

steps.title: Anchor Weighted Base Pedestal & Seat 6808 Slew Bearing
steps.note: Place PRT-01 (Weighted Base Pedestal) on the bench and press the 6808-2RS thin-section bearing (OTS-03) flush into the top 52.18mm counterbore.
steps.description: Place PRT-01 (Weighted Base Pedestal) on the bench and press the 6808-2RS thin-section bearing (OTS-03) flush into the top 52.18mm counterbore.

steps.title: Mount J1 Azimuth Turntable Deck with 25T Aluminum Horn
steps.note: Fasten a 25T aluminum disc horn (OTS-07) to the underside of PRT-02 (Turntable Deck) and seat PRT-02 onto the 6808-2RS bearing race.
steps.description: Fasten a 25T aluminum disc horn (OTS-07) to the underside of PRT-02 (Turntable Deck) and seat PRT-02 onto the 6808-2RS bearing race.

steps.title: Bolt J2 Shoulder U-Yoke & High-Torque MG996R Servos
steps.note: Bolt PRT-03 (Shoulder U-Yoke) to the turntable deck with 4× M3×12mm socket cap screws and install the J1/J2/J3 MG996R metal-gear servos (OTS-01).
steps.description: Bolt PRT-03 (Shoulder U-Yoke) to the turntable deck with 4× M3×12mm socket cap screws and install the J1/J2/J3 MG996R metal-gear servos (OTS-01).

steps.title: Install J2–J3 Triangulated Truss Lower Arm Link
steps.note: Slide the lower trunnion of PRT-04 (Truss Lower Arm Link) between the shoulder yoke arms and bolt to the J2 25T aluminum horn and opposing 608ZZ idler bearing.
steps.description: Slide the lower trunnion of PRT-04 (Truss Lower Arm Link) between the shoulder yoke arms and bolt to the J2 25T aluminum horn and opposing 608ZZ idler bearing.

steps.title: Couple J3 Cantilever Elbow Housing to Upper Truss
steps.note: Align PRT-05 (Elbow Servo Housing) with the top clevis of PRT-04 and secure the J3 MG996R horn and 608ZZ support bearing.
steps.description: Align PRT-05 (Elbow Servo Housing) with the top clevis of PRT-04 and secure the J3 MG996R horn and 608ZZ support bearing.

steps.title: Thread Harness & Seat J4 Hollow Wrist-Roll Forearm Barrel
steps.note: Route the wrist servo extension leads through the center bore of PRT-06 (Forearm Barrel) and couple its base flange to the J4 roll spline inside PRT-05.
steps.description: Route the wrist servo extension leads through the center bore of PRT-06 (Forearm Barrel) and couple its base flange to the J4 roll spline inside PRT-05.

steps.title: Attach J5 Wrist Pitch Clevis & Micro MG90S Servos
steps.note: Fasten PRT-07 (Wrist Pitch Clevis) to the distal flange of PRT-06 and seat the 3× MG90S metal-gear micro servos (OTS-02) into the J4, J5, and J6 mounts.
steps.description: Fasten PRT-07 (Wrist Pitch Clevis) to the distal flange of PRT-06 and seat the 3× MG90S metal-gear micro servos (OTS-02) into the J4, J5, and J6 mounts.

steps.title: Mount J6 Parallel Gripper Chassis to Wrist Gimbal
steps.note: Bolt PRT-08 (Spur-Gear Gripper Chassis) onto the J5 wrist pitch horn and verify unrestricted ±95° wrist articulation.
steps.description: Bolt PRT-08 (Spur-Gear Gripper Chassis) onto the J5 wrist pitch horn and verify unrestricted ±95° wrist articulation.

steps.title: Mesh Geared Parallel Gripper Jaws (×2)
steps.note: Set the J6 MG90S servo to closed position, mesh the 14-tooth spur gears of both PRT-09 Gripper Jaws symmetrically, and secure with M3×16mm pivot pins.
steps.description: Set the J6 MG90S servo to closed position, mesh the 14-tooth spur gears of both PRT-09 Gripper Jaws symmetrically, and secure with M3×16mm pivot pins.

steps.title: Wire PCA9685 PWM Driver, ESP32-S3 Controller & 6V 10A PSU
steps.note: Plug channels 0–5 from the servos into the PCA9685 board (OTS-04), connect SDA/SCL to the ESP32-S3 (OTS-05), and wire the 6V 10A PSU (OTS-06) to the V+ screw terminal.
steps.description: Plug channels 0–5 from the servos into the PCA9685 board (OTS-04), connect SDA/SCL to the ESP32-S3 (OTS-05), and wire the 6V 10A PSU (OTS-06) to the V+ screw terminal.
